def parse_demo(text,label):
    marker=re.search(r'Demo pair [0-9]+ '+label+r' \(([0-9]+x[0-9]+)\):\n',text)
    if not marker: raise ValueError(label)
    rows,cols=map(int,marker.group(1).split('x'))
    grid=[]
    for line in text[marker.end():].splitlines():
        vals=list(map(int,line.split()))
        if len(vals)==cols:
            grid.append(vals)
            if len(grid)==rows: break
        elif grid: break
    assert len(grid)==rows,(len(grid),rows)
